project_type: EaseMyOffice CRM — TanStack Start + React 19 SPA with Supabase (Postgres + RLS + Deno edge functions) backend, hosted on Cloudflare Workers. HRMS attendance module.
language: TypeScript (React frontend) + TypeScript on Deno (Supabase edge functions)
build_system: bun (package manager). Vite build. CI runs tsc --noEmit + vitest + build. No Docker.
test_framework: Vitest unit tests in src/lib/*.test.ts (e.g. attendance-rules.test.ts, hrms.test.ts). Playwright e2e in e2e/ (not run as part of the gate here).
verification_instructions: Full gate before done: (1) typecheck: ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit  — npx/node may be off PATH; if tsc missing, export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/vXX/bin:$PATH" (check ls /root/.nvm/versions/node for the actual version). (2) bun run test — all vitest files must pass. (3) bun run build — emits dist/server/index.js + wrangler.json and regenerates src/routeTree.gen.ts (commit it if it changes). Edge functions are NOT type-checked by CI; optionally `npx -y deno check supabase/functions/attendance-punch/index.ts` and delete any deno.lock it leaves.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/routeTree.gen.ts is regenerated by `bun run build` — commit it if it changes. No new route files are being added here, so it likely will not change.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/Easemyoffice && bun install --frozen-lockfile (562 packages, ~8s). Work on branch main (clean, synced with origin/main @ 25d01a4). Do NOT push or open a PR — the orchestrator publishes.
environment_constraints: No Supabase credentials in sandbox: cannot run SQL, cannot regenerate src/integrations/supabase/types.ts. HRMS tables are accessed via the hrmsDb() `any` cast + hand-written row types in src/lib/hrms.ts (NOT the generated types). ALL DB migrations are APPLIED MANUALLY BY THE OWNER after merge — author them idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS / DROP POLICY IF EXISTS), surface the full filename in the summary, and the app MUST degrade gracefully if the migration is not yet applied. npm registry IS reachable so bun install / build / tests run in-sandbox.
contribution_requirements: Strictly additive — existing punch, device approval, blocking, attendance, payroll, My Attendance must all keep working. New files must be prettier-clean (npx prettier --write <file>); touched existing files must gain no NEW eslint errors (repo has thousands of pre-existing prettier errors, so `bun run lint` fails repo-wide — compare per-file problem counts before/after). Keep pure logic in a tested helper. Code/comments in clean English.
key_patterns: 1) attendance-punch edge fn (supabase/functions/attendance-punch/index.ts) is the ONLY writer of attendance/devices, runs under service role, wraps everything in try/catch and ALWAYS returns 200 {ok,reason,message} for verdicts — any new query must be defensive and never throw the punch path. 2) Admin alerts use notifyAdmins(db, {type,title,body,details,path,cta}) from supabase/functions/_shared/hr-notify.ts (see the existing hr_remote_request alert at the bottom of index.ts for the exact shape incl. details rows and a Google-maps link). 3) src/lib/attendance-rules.ts MUST stay BYTE-IDENTICAL to supabase/functions/_shared/attendance-rules.ts (a vitest test enforces it) — do NOT put the shared-device helper there; put pure helpers in src/lib/hrms.ts (has hrms.test.ts). 4) DevicesView() in src/routes/_authenticated/hrms/attendance.tsx (~line 1543) renders the Devices tab; it uses useNames() (defined ~line 1347; names.emp.get(employee_id)->name), a `decide` useMutation that writes device status directly from the browser under admin RLS, and invalidates queryKeys ['hrms-devices'] + ['hrms-pending-devices']. 5) shadcn AlertDialog exists at src/components/ui/alert-dialog.tsx (radix dep installed) but is NOT yet used anywhere — this is the destructive-confirm component to use for Delete. 6) Buttons use shadcn Button with size='sm'; lucide-react icons (Ban, Check, Smartphone already imported; add Trash2). 7) hrmsDb() = supabase cast to any for HRMS tables.
